verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is a well-documented partner API/platform explicitly built for developers to embed white-labeled payroll, benefits, contractors, and time-off into their own products, with pre-built UI flows, APIs, webhooks, demo environments, and API credentials for partners. Extensive first-party docs cover onboarding, payroll processing, contractor payments, webhooks, idempotency, and even an MCP dev-assistant server for building integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports validating the embedded API integration experience specifically (community evidence found is about end-customer HR/payroll experience, not the partner API itself).
